transition.description:
Page transition, powered by Vue's `<TransitionGroup/>`

Built-in transitions:
- fade
- fade-out
- slide-left
- slide-right
- slide-up
- slide-down
- view-transition

See https://sli.dev/guide/animations.html#pages-transitions

See https://vuejs.org/guide/built-ins/transition.html

Default to 'cover' for the first slide, 'default' for the rest

routeAlias.description: Create a route alias that can be used in the URL or with the `<Link>` component
routeAlias.markdownDescription: Create a route alias that can be used in the URL or with the `<Link>` component

slug.description:
URL-safe slug used in per-slide OG / share URLs (e.g. `/<n>-<slug>.html`).

Defaults to `routeAlias` if set, else a slugified `title` / first `h1`, else `slide-<n>`.
slug.markdownDescription:
URL-safe slug used in per-slide OG / share URLs (e.g. `/<n>-<slug>.html`).

Defaults to `routeAlias` if set, else a slugified `title` / first `h1`,
else `slide-<n>`.

description.description: Per-slide OG description. If absent, the first paragraph of the slide is used.
description.markdownDescription: Per-slide OG description. If absent, the first paragraph of the slide is used.

ogImage.description: Per-slide OG image. If unset, an image is auto-rendered at `slidev build` time via the existing PNG export pipeline. Path is relative to the deck root.
ogImage.markdownDescription:
Per-slide OG image. If unset, an image is auto-rendered at `slidev build` time
via the existing PNG export pipeline. Path is relative to the deck root.

caption.description: Text of this slide's post when the deck is published as a thread (`slidev publish bluesky`). Defaults to the slide's OG title. Markdown links (`[text](url)`) and bare URLs become links in the post.
caption.markdownDescription:

skipOg.description: Skip this slide from OG-shell + image generation (and from social threads).
skipOg.markdownDescription: Skip this slide from OG-shell + image generation (and from social threads).

skipThread.description: Omit this slide from published threads (`slidev publish bluesky`), keeping its OG shell and image.
skipThread.markdownDescription:

params.description: URL params this slide reads (e.g. a view-mode toggle), so the Worker deploy target (`publish.worker`) can give `/<n>?m=heatmap` its own share card. The Worker canonicalizes them: unknown params and values are dropped, defaults are dropped, the rest sorted.

dragPos.description:
Store the positions of draggable elements Normally you don't need to set this manually

See https://sli.dev/features/draggable
dragPos.markdownDescription:
Store the positions of draggable elements
Normally you don't need to set this manually

See https://sli.dev/features/draggable

dragLayout.description:
How draggable elements on this slide are positioned.

- `'absolute'` - taken out of the layout; positions are relative to the slide.
- `'flow'` - keep their place in the layout (grids, columns, flex); moving shifts them visually   without reflowing their neighbors, and resizing resizes their layout slot.

Set it for every slide via `defaults`. Single elements opt in with `v-drag.flow` or `<v-drag flow>`.
